nodes.node_name: Fusion Confinement Route and System Architecture
nodes.description: Magnetic-confinement tokamaks and stellarators, field-reversed configurations, Z-pinch and other experimental fusion architectures; route progress is not commercial power generation.
NbTi, Nb3Sn and REBCO conductors, TF/CS/PF magnets, quench protection, cryostats, helium refrigeration and qualification for fusion-specific magnetic systems.

nodes.node_name: Pulsed Power, Heating, Current Drive, and Protection
nodes.description: Ion/electron cyclotron heating, microwave tubes, neutral-beam and pulsed-power systems, high-current switches, current drive, disruption and quench protection controls.

nodes.node_name: Vacuum, Gas, Tritium, and Fuel-Cycle Systems
nodes.description: High-vacuum vessels and pumps, glow-discharge cleaning, helium and hydrogen-isotope processing, tritium extraction, separation, containment and fuel-cycle safety systems.

nodes.node_name: First Wall, Blanket, Divertor, Shielding, and Materials
nodes.description: Plasma-facing tungsten and copper heat sinks, first-wall and blanket structures, divertors, neutron shielding, cooling interfaces and high-heat-flux qualification for fusion devices.

nodes.node_name: Plasma Diagnostics, Measurement, Simulation, and Control
nodes.description: Magnetic, microwave, optical, particle and thermal diagnostics, data acquisition, plasma simulation, real-time control and machine-protection validation.
Large thin-wall forming, special-material joining, leak testing, dimensional control, factory acceptance, installation and qualification of fusion-specific components.
Cross-system integration, site installation, commissioning, plasma campaigns, maintenance, radiation and tritium safety, availability and operational learning for experimental facilities.

nodes.node_name: Project, Order, Delivery, and Revenue Validation
nodes.description: Project approval, tender, contract, production, delivery, acceptance, recognized equipment revenue and cash collection; facility orders are distinct from commercial fusion-power revenue.
